source_review_scope: All three complete original bodies, target extents, call/global contracts, natural C behavior and focused fixtures reviewed. Native/Docker code and fixups agree for each case.

issues.finding: Matcher could not verify direct recursive calls represented by a defined COFF symbol.
issues.resolution: Narrow exact-self-symbol path; unchanged complete span and operand requirements; six new failure/positive test methods; independent worker tooling review found no material issue.

issues.finding: Square cell enumerator parameter order was wrong in candidate and shared fixture header.
issues.resolution: Caller push order and callee accesses independently confirm cells, position, radius, capacity. Candidate/header/stub corrected; parent final fixture verifies argument identity and passes 81 checks. Campaign rule now requires both caller and callee ABI evidence.

issues.finding: Collector worker handoff overstated all twelve later operand offsets as one byte early.
issues.resolution: Independent parent COFF diagnostic: first thirteen and last align, ten are one byte early, one is two bytes early. Historical worker claim retained with correction; final receipt uses actual positions.

issues.finding: Surface fixture label qualifying callback order checks callback counts only.
issues.resolution: Coverage limitation explicitly recorded; initial collect/reset/next order is tested and geometry-before-containment order was statically reviewed. No claim of complete dynamic callback-order coverage.

coordinator_changes.model_hierarchy: FUNCTION annotation only in candidate; formatted and expanded fixture from 9 to 17 checks.
coordinator_changes.surface_below: FUNCTION annotation only in candidate; expanded fixture from 38 to 53 checks.

limitations: Passing authored fixtures cover selected behavior, not integrated game correctness.
Hierarchy remains above the 5% scheduling threshold; surface extent and collector operand locations prevent exact comparison.
All compiler attempts count toward existing caps; no automatic polishing or cap reset.
